en-US.description: hiro is a personal test build with customizable on-screen presentation, viewing protection and device connectivity.
en-US.whats_new: Updates the editor's available range and adds finer duration choices for short sessions and sessions up to one hour. Please check value selection, estimated totals and progress display.

zh-Hans.description: hiro 是用于个人测试的应用版本，提供可自定义的界面展示、查看保护和设备连接功能。
zh-Hans.whats_new: 调整编辑页可选范围，细化短时操作及一小时内的时间选项。请检查数值选择、预计总量和运行进度显示。
